fields.status: Latest maintainer release v0.4 was published 2022-09-12. The DS branch continued with ARM9/ITCM optimization work through 2026-05-10. The README still warns that sound may fail on most flashcarts and marks the two-screen mode broken.

sources.label: Latest commit on the Nintendo DS branch: ARM9/ITCM optimization (2026-05-10T20:41:58Z)
Maintainer README: DS build options, flashcart caveats, and two-screen mode limitation
Latest maintainer release v0.4 (2022-09-12)

fields.status: Maintainer release v1.0.0 (2026-10-05) claims 100% decompilation across ARM9, ARM7, and three overlays: 7,140 functions and 279,930 lines of pseudo-C. The current status document still lists some mechanics and map-name research as incomplete or uncertain. The latest repository commit (2026-10-07) adds security-reporting guidance; the reviewed README, status document, and release do not document a byte-matching ROM build.

sources.label: Maintainer v1.0.0 release and coverage claim (2026-10-05)
Maintainer README: target revision and decompilation overview
Maintainer status inventory: completed components and remaining research
